meta.title: dsh-deepseek-official-status[Official Service Status]
meta.description: Live DeepSeek official service status (status.deepseek.com) as a traffic-light dot in the conversation header: colour for the overall state, hover for per-component status and uptime, plus active and recent incidents. When the source is unreadable it degrades explicitly and keeps the last snapshot instead of pretending everything is fine.
